newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Federal sets cost-cutting plan.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Federal sets cost-cutting plan.

text.p: Fidelity Federal Bancorp said Tuesday it will launch a cost-cutting plan that will affect an unspecified number of employees.
M. Brian Davis, Fidelity Federal's president and chief executive officer, said the program will take three to six months to complete. He declined to specify how many jobs will be eliminated.
"The bulk (of the job cuts) will happen immediately, but I see the timetable running between three and six months," he said.
Davis said the bank and its affiliiates currently have a total of 140 employees. He said the company hopes to save about $1 million after taxes, or $0.36 per share.
Fidelity Federal is the parent of United Fidelity Bank.
Its shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 9-3/4.
